common_startup.note: one bounded query wait, then actual epoch; no covariance-based rejection picking

observation.actual_phase: assigned gate1/2; actual capture relation is outcome, all assigned runs retained

comparability.design: randomized blocked; no exact same-state claim
mandatory_discrete: no capture-only repair effect before first experimental capture
allowed_discrete_uncertainty: absolute simulator clock and call index
comparability.limit_basis: P11 experimental p/v/SO3/hidden/action limits retained; history same action scale; filter30rad/s=3% configured1000rad/s max, diagnostic only. Neither these limits nor natural variance prove a deterministic set. No limits enlarged after observations.
comparability.over_limit: retain in intention-to-treat blocked analysis, report initial imbalance, invalidate strict pair claim; do not remove or rerun
comparability.analysis: block contrasts all assigned branches; randomized gate effect by assignment, actual phase/NOT_REACHED outcomes; no post-treatment filtering; predeclared initial covariates for sensitivity only
comparability.theory_applicability: separate UNKNOWN full feedback set; absolute network bound2 never experimental stop

stop: new critical observation, identity, protection, or protocol error stops affected revision; flight safety failures remain scientific outcomes; no retry of started ID
catchup: cancel controlled catchup: apparatus not validated; no additional timing disturbance flights; Q3 natural/legal recorded clock words only
